:::{#sol-cross-entropy-numeric-entropy}

The [range](random-variables.qmd#def-range) of $X$ is $\set{1, 2, 3}$, and $\P(X = k) = p_k$, so

$$
\ba
\entropyf{X}
&= -\sum_{k \in \rangef{X}} \P(X = k) \log_2 \P(X = k) \\
&= -\tfrac{1}{2} \log_2 \tfrac{1}{2} - \tfrac{1}{4} \log_2 \tfrac{1}{4} - \tfrac{1}{4} \log_2 \tfrac{1}{4} \\
&= \tfrac{3}{2} \text{ bits}.
\ea
$$

This equals $H(p, p)$, because the two [sums](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-sums.html#def-summation) have the same terms.

:::
